## Summary

The chart was failing when the case of the config keys didn't match the SQL result column names (e.g. config `data_key: "revenue"` vs data column `"Revenue"`), because recharts looks up values by exact key on each data row.

Changes made:

1. **`apps/frontend/src/lib/charts.utils.ts`** — added a `resolveDataKey` helper that maps a config key to the actual key present in the data, matching case-insensitively (falling back to the original key if there's no match).

2. **`apps/frontend/src/components/tool-calls/display-chart.tsx`**:
   - In `ChartDisplay`, the incoming `xAxisKey` and each series' `data_key` are now resolved against the actual `data` keys before being used everywhere (chart config, legend, colors, `buildChart`).
   - In `DisplayChartToolCall`, the date sort/filter also resolves `config.x_axis_key` against the data so date-range filtering keeps working when the case differs.

This keeps a single source of truth (the actual data column names) while still honoring whatever case the LLM produced for the config, so charts render correctly regardless of casing.
